judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements usage accumulation across tool rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, handles missing per-round usage without poisoning totals or returning `NaN`, and satisfies all acceptance criteria including a dedicated three-call (two tool rounds) test. To make the hook signature unambiguous, the candidate introduces a `TurnUsageMetadata` type alias rather than renaming the parameter to `totalUsage` as the reference does, which is a reasonable alternative but leaves the `OrchestratorHooks` doc-block in `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` and `CLAUDE.md` out of sync with the source interface. Additionally, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate rewrites the bullet in place under the `Measured semantics — out of scope` heading instead of moving the newly supported behavior into the main spec section like the reference. Finally, the candidate leaves behind a `.lore/dod.md` artifact and splits the new tests across `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` and a new `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than placing them alongside the existing usage test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
